question: Which of the following Table Tennis World Championship events was held in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**19th World Championships, 1952**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 19th World Table Tennis Championships were held in Bombay (now Mumbai), India, in 1952.
 
• This event marked the first time that the World Table Tennis Championships were hosted in India.
 
• The Championships featured both men's and women's events, including singles, doubles, and mixed doubles competitions.
 
• India's hosting of the event was significant in promoting the sport within the country and the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Table Tennis World Championships:**

 
 
• The Table Tennis World Championships are an international event organized by the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF).
 
• The first World Championships were held in London in 1926.
 
• The Championships include events for both individual players and national teams.
 
• Over the years, the Championships have been held in various countries around the world, showcasing the global popularity of the sport.
 
 
 
• **International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF):**
 
 
• The ITTF is the governing body for all international table tennis associations.
 
• It was founded in 1926 and is responsible for the organization of numerous international competitions, including the World Table Tennis Championships.
 
• The ITTF oversees the rules and regulations of the sport, ensuring fair play and standardization across the globe.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Hosting International Events:**
 
 
• Hosting international sports events can significantly boost a country's visibility and reputation in the global arena.
